thought.text: Sangat informatif. Dengan `Origin/Referer` → **404**. Tanpa → 400 `invalid_request`. Jadi header Referer saya merusak routing. Saya uji tanpa Origin/Referer tapi dengan token asli.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
p='amtest.py'; t=open(p).read()
t=t.replace('''            "Origin": "https://dash.allmodels.io",
            "Referer": PAGE,
''','')
open(p,'w').write(t); print("Origin/Referer dihapus")
PY
timeout 280 python3 amtest.py 2>&1 | tail -18
